cases.prompt: I am starting a substantial change in an unfamiliar repo. Decide what context to load and whether to proceed or ask me first.
cases.expected_behavior: Apply rule precedence, inspect the repo, and proceed on reversible work while escalating only material authority choices.

cases.prompt: Keep the implementation professional but align the handoff and UI choices with my established preferences from this repository.
cases.expected_behavior: Load relevant profile sections, distinguish observed from inferred preferences, and avoid applying unrelated defaults.

cases.prompt: Fix the typo in this one README sentence.
cases.expected_behavior: Make the narrow edit without loading the full operating profile or performing project orientation.

cases.prompt: Review this dashboard mockup: it has a hero, three decorative cards, and no loading or error states. Make it useful for daily operations.
cases.expected_behavior: Remove generic decoration, preserve useful operational grouping, and add or report missing workflow states with rendered evidence.

cases.prompt: The benchmark report ranks models with one unexplained composite score. Critique the result before publication.
cases.expected_behavior: Separate the measured dimensions, expose weighting assumptions, and remove unsupported universal claims.

cases.prompt: Run the existing unit test command and tell me whether it passed.
cases.expected_behavior: Run the requested focused command and report its result without an unnecessary anti-slop review.

cases.prompt: We can hand-parse a real grammar or add a maintained parser dependency. Decide which approach fits this service.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect local patterns and constraints, compare maintenance and correctness, then choose or ask only if the tradeoff is personal or irreversible.

cases.prompt: Two module boundaries could support this feature. Give one recommendation with the assumptions and a condition for revisiting it.
cases.expected_behavior: Use repository evidence, keep the options bounded, recommend the smallest reversible choice, and record consequences.

cases.prompt: Implement the exact architecture I already selected in the issue.
cases.expected_behavior: Honor the explicit decision and focus on implementation unless new evidence reveals a blocking conflict.

cases.prompt: Before merging this API change, determine which checks are sufficient and what evidence the handoff must report.
cases.expected_behavior: Map changed contracts to proportional tests and checks, review the final diff, and report skipped verification or risk.

cases.prompt: Audit whether this research project actually satisfies its stopping conditions before we call it complete.
cases.expected_behavior: Check every stated outcome against direct evidence and continue or report remaining gaps rather than relying on a plausible narrative.

cases.prompt: Orient me to this repository before we choose the first feature.
cases.expected_behavior: Build a compact project map; do not perform a completion audit before any work exists.

cases.prompt: Build a new operations dashboard for dense daily scanning, with filters, status, and clear failure states.
cases.expected_behavior: Define a domain-specific visual direction, implement the workflow and states, and avoid generic marketing composition.

cases.prompt: Create the first viewport for a product page that must show the actual object and lead users into the next section.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the subject as the visual thesis, preserve the real object in the first viewport, and keep typography and layout intentional.

cases.prompt: Review this existing page at 390px and 1440px and list the most important UX defects.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect rendered states and report evidence-based findings without inventing a new design direction.

cases.prompt: Use the running app to inspect the checkout flow on desktop and mobile, including validation and server-error states.
cases.expected_behavior: Exercise realistic states, check interaction and layout stability, and report prioritized findings with viewport evidence.

cases.prompt: The screenshot looks polished, but I need evidence that keyboard focus, reduced motion, and empty states work.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect behavior beyond the polished screenshot and mark anything unavailable as untested.

cases.prompt: Choose a palette and typography direction for a new analytics interface.
cases.expected_behavior: Design the direction rather than reviewing a rendered artifact.

cases.prompt: Implement a typed validation boundary for this API and add tests for malformed payloads.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect local patterns, make invalid states explicit, preserve the contract, and test observable behavior.

cases.prompt: Refactor this shared module without breaking existing callers or introducing a speculative abstraction.
cases.expected_behavior: Trace ownership and compatibility, make a focused structural change, and verify callers and tests.

cases.prompt: Review this pull request for correctness and security; do not change the files.
cases.expected_behavior: Review intent, tests, and changed paths and report findings without mutating the patch.

cases.prompt: Design a reproducible benchmark for comparing two actuarial methods, including uncertainty and assumptions.
cases.expected_behavior: Define metrics separately, preserve data lineage and method details, and avoid arbitrary composite rankings.

cases.prompt: Check whether these five claims in a technical report are actually supported by credible sources.
cases.expected_behavior: Map material claims to inspectable sources, expose conflicts, and calibrate certainty.

cases.prompt: Fix the failing test in the parser and run the focused test suite.
cases.expected_behavior: Debug and implement against repository evidence rather than conducting a research-quality source review.

cases.prompt: Draft the pull request description with the result first, verification, limitations, and no marketing language.
cases.expected_behavior: Write concise findings-first project communication tied to actual evidence.

cases.prompt: Turn these research notes into a short README section that distinguishes facts, assumptions, and open risks.
cases.expected_behavior: Use plain active language and preserve uncertainty without inflating claims.

cases.prompt: Add the requested endpoint and tests to the service.
cases.expected_behavior: Implement the behavior; do not trigger a writing workflow unless a communication artifact is requested.

cases.prompt: Inspect PR 31, address valid review feedback, run checks, merge it, and verify the final GitHub state.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect live threads and checks, implement only authorized fixes, merge with current evidence, and confirm the result.

cases.prompt: The pull request CI is red. Read the failing job and logs before deciding what to change.
cases.expected_behavior: Diagnose the current check state and root cause before editing or publishing.

cases.prompt: Implement this local helper in the current working tree; do not push or open a PR.
cases.expected_behavior: Make the local change and verify it without external GitHub actions.

cases.prompt: Add a feature that spans the API, database migration, UI controls, tests, and documentation. Carry it through to a verified handoff.
cases.expected_behavior: Orient, define scope, implement incrementally, cover states and compatibility, and report direct evidence.

cases.prompt: Implement the requested UI action and make sure pending, success, validation, access, and server-error states are complete.
cases.expected_behavior: Build the workflow rather than only styling the happy path, then verify relevant renders.

cases.prompt: Read this diff and tell me whether it should merge. Do not edit it.
cases.expected_behavior: Review and report findings without turning a review-only task into implementation.

cases.prompt: Review this PR for regressions, security issues, and missing tests. Put actionable findings first with file and line references.
cases.expected_behavior: Understand intent and tests, trace important paths, and report concrete findings ordered by severity.

cases.prompt: Perform a second pass over this API patch and say clearly if there are no findings, including remaining test gaps.
cases.expected_behavior: Review the current patch without rewriting it and distinguish no findings from unverified risk.

cases.prompt: Build the missing authorization check and add a regression test.
cases.expected_behavior: Implement and verify the fix rather than producing review findings only.

cases.prompt: Review the running admin screen at 375px and 1440px and fix only defects that block or degrade the main workflow.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect rendered states, prioritize user impact, make focused authorized fixes, and rerender affected states.

cases.prompt: Is this dashboard ready for frontend merge? Check keyboard access, error states, text fit, and responsive layout.
cases.expected_behavior: Review the rendered workflow and report evidence-based readiness or blockers.

cases.prompt: Design a new dashboard from this product brief and choose an intentional visual direction.
cases.expected_behavior: Create the interface direction and workflow; do not review an artifact that does not yet exist.

cases.prompt: Investigate whether Playwright, Cypress, or browser DevTools is the best fit for this repository and recommend one.
cases.expected_behavior: Frame decisive evidence, inspect primary sources and local fit, compare options, and synthesize a conditional recommendation.

cases.prompt: Research the evidence for a new mortality model, reproduce the relevant benchmark, and explain domain limitations.
cases.expected_behavior: Preserve data lineage, method details, uncertainty, contradictions, and domain-specific limitations.

cases.prompt: Use this official API page to verify one parameter name in our code.
cases.expected_behavior: Perform a narrow source verification and code correction without launching a broad research project.

cases.prompt: We just cloned this monorepo. Map the packages, commands, tests, generated files, and the narrowest first milestone.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect progressively, cite real paths and verified commands, identify boundaries, and define a testable first outcome.

cases.prompt: Start work on this unfamiliar service without reading the entire repository. Give me a compact project map first.
cases.expected_behavior: Load only relevant persistent and task context, then state evidence, inferences, risks, and next workflow.

cases.prompt: The exact file and test command are already known. Add the requested one-line fix and report the result.
cases.expected_behavior: Skip broad orientation and make the narrow change with proportional verification.

cases.prompt: Build this product UI so it looks authored by a senior human designer and cannot be reused for an unrelated product by changing only the labels.
cases.expected_behavior: Derive hierarchy, content, interaction, and visual direction from the product domain, apply the relabeling test, and reject interchangeable AI-template composition.

cases.prompt: Rewrite this document so it reads like a knowledgeable human wrote it, without canned transitions, repetitive conclusions, or generic AI-response structure.
cases.expected_behavior: Reconstruct the prose from its evidence, audience, and purpose; preserve required disclosure and do not optimize mechanically for detector scores.

cases.prompt: Develop this AI-assisted actuarial paper to a publishable human-expert standard with a real contribution, rigorous literature synthesis, reproducible methods, verified citations, and natural prose.
cases.expected_behavior: Build a claim-evidence argument, verify every material citation and calculation, report uncertainty and limitations, line-edit synthetic prose patterns, and follow venue disclosure rules.

cases.prompt: This integration test fails only in CI. Reproduce what you can, trace the value across workflow, build, and test boundaries, then fix the confirmed cause and add a regression check.
cases.expected_behavior: Collect boundary evidence, form and test one hypothesis at a time, fix the originating condition, and verify the original CI-relevant path without exposing secrets.

cases.prompt: A production worker times out intermittently after a recent release. Diagnose the cause without simply increasing every timeout, then state what remains unverified outside production.
cases.expected_behavior: Separate mitigation from diagnosis, compare the release and timing evidence, test a falsifiable bottleneck hypothesis, and calibrate the completion claim to available production evidence.

cases.prompt: The typo causing this exact syntax error is already identified on line 12. Correct it and run the focused parser test.
cases.expected_behavior: Make the known mechanical correction and verify it without launching an unnecessary root-cause investigation.

cases.prompt: Implement a multi-tenant endpoint that lets account administrators update billing contacts. Include authorization, validation, audit behavior, and cross-tenant regression tests.
cases.expected_behavior: Derive actor and tenant from validated authentication state, enforce server-side object and action authorization, constrain accepted fields, audit the privileged change, and test cross-tenant denial.

cases.prompt: Design the browser session and password-reset flow for this application. Decide between sessions and tokens from the architecture, protect secrets, and do not default sensitive material to localStorage.
cases.expected_behavior: Model the clients and trust boundaries, choose established primitives, define cookie or token validation and lifecycle, protect recovery, and explain residual tradeoffs without inventing cryptography.

cases.prompt: Rename this internal variable and update its unit test; no API, data, authentication, dependency, or deployment behavior changes.
cases.expected_behavior: Make the low-risk refactor with focused verification without loading a security workflow that cannot change the outcome.

cases.prompt: Review this pull request for security issues. It adds an object lookup endpoint, file upload parsing, and an outbound webhook call; do not modify the patch.
cases.expected_behavior: Trace attacker influence through authorization, file handling, and outbound request controls; report only reachable findings with evidence, confidence, impact, and focused remedies.

cases.prompt: Audit this GitHub Actions release workflow for untrusted pull-request input, excessive permissions, dependency execution, and secret exposure. Return findings only.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect event trust, permissions, checkout and dependency behavior, expression use, and credential reachability; distinguish confirmed risks from deployment facts that need verification.

cases.prompt: Implement a new password-reset flow with secure token lifecycle, session invalidation, and regression tests.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the secure implementation workflow because the request authorizes changes; do not substitute a review-only report for the requested feature.

cases.prompt: Tailor my software engineering resume to this backend internship description. Keep every claim truthful, improve the bullets, and show me any missing evidence.
cases.expected_behavior: Map requirements to verified experience, foreground relevant evidence, improve action-context-result bullets, and flag gaps rather than inventing skills or metrics.

cases.prompt: Audit this CV for ATS parsing and recruiter readability, then revise the structure without promising an ATS score.
cases.expected_behavior: Inspect headings, reading order, dates, contact text, evidence density, and target alignment while explaining that parser behavior varies by employer and vendor.

cases.prompt: Rewrite my LinkedIn headline and About section for data engineering roles; I am not changing my resume.
cases.expected_behavior: Use the public-profile workflow and avoid loading the full resume and ATS process for a LinkedIn-only request.
